intro: Deep in the jungle's fog, Norman, the Petalburg Gym Leader, stands silently.
introDialogue: I didn't expect to meet anyone in this deep jungle. I am Norman, the Petalburg Gym Leader. Shall we test your passion as a trainer?
speaker: Norman
title: One-Pyeong Jungle
description: An old card illuminates the center of the jungle. The dense forest inside the card sways like a real breeze, reflecting a forgotten altar leading somewhere.
query: Show me the path you have chosen. How will you continue your training?

1.label: Approach into the Jungle
1.selectedDialogue: Good! Test your limits against the wild beasts of this jungle!

2.label: Subdue the Guardian
2.tooltip: (+) Boss battle with powerful ???? (Uncatchable, random high-tier item)
2.selectedDialogue: Are you ready to face the guardian? Show me your unwavering fighting spirit!

3.label: Rest Beside the Altar
3.selectedDialogue: Rest is just as important as training. Restore your strength here.

4.label: Listen to the Whispers
4.tooltip:
(+) Boss battle with ???? (Uncatchable)
(+) Change a Pokemon's ability and unlock its Passive
4.selectPrompt: Choose a Pokemon to receive the whispers.
4.selectedDialogue: Awakening a Pokemon's hidden strength is also a trainer's duty. First, overcome the jungle's trial.
4.finished: The whispers of the jungle unlocked {{selectedPokemon}}'s Passive and changed its ability to {{abilityName}}!

outro: Never waver on your journey. Keep moving forward, and I look forward to your growth.
